name: Panax notoginseng extract
description: Panax notoginseng extract (CAS 94279-78-4 ), also known commercially as Tian Qi extract or San Qi extract, is a standardized botanical derived from the root of Panax notoginseng. It is sourced primarily for its concentrated notoginsenoside and ginsenoside content. This high-purity extract drives demand across nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, and cosmetic supply chains. In dietary supplement manufacturing, it is incorporated into capsules, tablets, and functional beverages targeting cardiovascular health. Pharmaceutical formulators use standardized extracts as active botanical ingredients in finished dosage forms. These applications require that ginsenoside content must meet defined specifications for therapeutic efficacy and safety. In functional food development, it is added to fortified products where antioxidant activity supports product claims and shelf-life stability. This versatility makes it a staple ingredient for modern health-focused food brands. Cosmetic formulators incorporate it into serums, creams, and tonics targeting skin tone and oxidative stress protection. It is frequently utilized in anti-aging positioning due to its potent bioactive profile and skin-soothing properties. The extract is supplied as a fine powder, typically brown to off-white in color depending on the processing method. Standard grades are available with defined notoginsenoside content, commonly 20%, 40%, or 80% by HPLC. These concentrations are designed to meet pharmaceutical and nutraceutical specification requirements. Food-grade and cosmetic-grade variants are available, with buyers typically requesting certificates of analysis for quality assurance. Suppliers ensure compliance by confirming active content, heavy metal limits, and pesticide residue levels.
